 Texans Getting RB David Montgomery Back In Week 11; Team Rules Out Marvin Harrison Jr., Danielle Hunter
 By Ely Allen |
 at November 18, 2026 10:17 pm 
 After over a month on the injury report, Texans running back David Montgomery had no injury listing after the team’s practices over the short week and appears to be on track to play in his first game since Week 5. Unfortunately, though, as Houston prepares to take on the division-rival Colts tomorrow night, the team has ruled out defensive end Danielle Hunter , wide receiver Marvin Harrison Jr. , running back Woody Marks , and tight end Brevin Jordan .
 Marks took over lead back duties after Montgomery went down, so the veteran should be able to tag right back into the starting role as Marks sits this week. Montgomery didn’t even practice for four weeks as he dealt with a groin injury but was able to fit in a limited practice last Thursday before ending the week as a full participant. Marks was dealing with a knee issue heading into last week’s game, but he suffered a concussion in the loss to the Browns and hasn’t quite made it out of the NFL’s concussion protocol to suit up tomorrow.
 Hunter and Harrison both missed last week’s game with hamstring injuries and will be held out this week for the same issue. Houston has continued to enjoy the healthy returns of Nico Collins and Tank Dell as Harrison’s absence adds to the losses of Jayden Higgins and Jaylin Noel . Similarly, Hunter’s absence is tough on a defensive line with four players on injured reserve, but the offseason addition of former No. 1 overall pick Jadeveon Clowney has given the team a strong replacement option to start opposite Will Anderson Jr. 
 The Colts ruled out a number of contributors for their mid-week trip to Houston, as well. They’ll be without both starting bookends on the offensive line as Bernhard Raimann misses with a concussion and Jalen Travis continues working through a knee injury. On the defensive side of the ball, veteran defensive tackle Jerry Tillery will miss his second straight game with a calf injury, and cornerback Charvarius Ward is out this week with a knee injury.
 Lastly, Colts tight end Will Mallory will join his fellow former Miami (FL) tight end, Jordan, in sitting out this week as he misses his second straight game with a hamstring issue. Both were commits in the Hurricanes’ 2018 class. Jordan amassed 1,358 yards and 13 touchdowns in three seasons before leaving for the NFL and allowing Mallory two more years as the lead tight end to finish his career in Coral Gables with 1,544 yards and 14 touchdowns. They both found their homes in the AFC South as fifth-round picks but have seen injuries limit their careers, so far. Injuries will remain a factor as they both sit out this week.
